$comment: Canvas tool contract (docs/ai-integration.md § Agent tool set). Advertised by the Rust MCP server (include_str!) and executed by src/agent/sceneTools.ts. Every tool accepts optional tabId (default: active tab). Read tools return `revision`; edit tools accept `expectedRevision` and fail with a conflict if the scene changed.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open canvas tabs with id, title, element count, and whether the agent may edit it (viewer tabs in a live collab session are read-only).

tools.name: get_scene_summary
tools.description: Compact one-row-per-element summary (id, type, x, y, w, h, text, colors, bindings) plus scene bounds and revision. Paginate with cursor, or filter by bbox or ids. Call this before editing.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Return the ids and summaries of the user's currently selected elements, plus revision.

tools.name: get_elements
tools.description: Return full Excalidraw element JSON for the given ids, plus revision.

tools.name: render_canvas_png
tools.description: Render the canvas to a PNG (longest side <= 1280px) so you can see the result. scope: all | viewport | selection | ids.

tools.name: add_elements
tools.description: Add elements in Excalidraw skeleton format (type rectangle|ellipse|diamond|text|arrow|line|frame, x, y, width, height, label {text}, strokeColor, backgroundColor, start/end {id} for arrows). Optional agent-chosen ids must not collide. Returns created ids and new revision.

tools.name: update_elements
tools.description: Patch existing elements. Allowed fields: x, y, width, height, angle, strokeColor, backgroundColor, fillStyle, strokeWidth, strokeStyle, roughness, opacity, text, fontSize, fontFamily, textAlign, roundness, locked, link. Bound arrows are re-routed.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete elements by id (also removes their bound text and dangling bound arrows).

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Draw a bound arrow between two existing elements, optionally labeled.

tools.name: add_mermaid
tools.description: Convert Mermaid source (flowchart, sequence, class...) to native Excalidraw elements and place them at an optional position. Reports when the diagram type fell back to an image.

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Arrange elements: align (left|center|right|top|middle|bottom), distribute (horizontal|vertical), grid {columns,gap}, group, ungroup, or z-order (front|back).

tools.name: set_viewport
tools.description: Scroll/zoom the user's view to fit the given ids (or the whole scene). Does not change the drawing or create an undo step.

tools.name: apply_ops
tools.description: Run several edit operations atomically as one undo step. Each op is {tool, args} using add_elements, update_elements, delete_elements, connect, add_mermaid, or arrange.

internalTools.name: approve
internalTools.description: Internal: Claude Code --permission-prompt-tool target. Handled in Rust (routes to an in-app approval card); never forwarded to the webview.
